name: Action Scheduler vs WP-Cron for payment webhook synchronization
query: We are adding background payment reconciliation to sync transaction statuses from Stripe. We currently use WP-Cron for small tasks, but payments are mission-critical and must not be dropped when site traffic is low. Should we adopt Action Scheduler?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Inspect repository and detect existing background job patterns via detect-project.mjs
Step 2: Trigger ADR-worthiness gate -> ADR_REQUIRED (financial consistency, high reliability requirement, cross-cutting)
Step 3: Capture decision drivers: execution reliability on low-traffic sites, automatic retries with backoff, admin queue visibility
Step 4: Present Intent Summary comparing native WP-Cron vs Action Scheduler vs external worker
Step 6: Draft ADR deciding on Action Scheduler as the background processor
Step 7: Define durable constraints: All background jobs must be idempotent; jobs must pass record IDs rather than serialized objects
Step 8: Define verification: Integration test verifying Action Scheduler hook dispatch; WP-CLI command wp action-scheduler status
Step 9: Run validate-adr.mjs to ensure compliance
success_criteria: ADR successfully created with clean validation
